## Goal

`norn status --watch [--interval] [--pane] [--json]` replaces `norn cockpit`; `norn run attach [<unit>] [--next]` focuses an agent pane (AC1–AC7).

## Progress

- Commit ef385de. The cockpit command moved to `packages/cli/src/runtime/status-watch.ts`; `status` routes `--watch` there. Using `--pane` or `--interval` without `--watch` is a usage error.
- `--pane` goes through a new HerdrCockpit port method `openBelow` (split down at ratio 0.3, renamed `norn`), so the fake Herdr records it. The adapter's `openCockpitPane` and its tests were replaced by an `openBelow` argv test. Outside Herdr it is refused `not_in_herdr` with do_instead `norn status --watch`.
- New command `packages/cli/src/commands/run-attach.ts`. It finds each unit's live pane from the reach on its inbox items. With no pane (or no Herdr) it is refused `nothing_to_attach`, with do_instead set to the unit's Your turn command, else `norn status`. A target is resolved with `resolveTarget`, which offers only units with a live pane. `--next` keeps the success JSON `{focused, item}`. Two cases are now refused `nothing_to_attach`: no Your turn agent at all, and an agent with no pane (the old JSON had `focused: null` and `command`; that command is now the do_instead).
- `cmd.cockpit` is replaced by `cmd.statusWatch`, and `cmd.runAttach` was added (the printed-commands table is updated).
- Tests: `cockpit.test.ts` moved to `status-watch.test.ts` on the new commands. The e2e test for the `norn run` verbs now includes attach.
- AC7 was checked by hand under a pty (python `pty`): in a throwaway repo it drew 4 frames in 3.5s at `--interval 1s` and quit on q with exit 0.
- Left for slice 15: the Herdr plugin (`plugins/herdr/next.sh` etc.) still calls `cockpit` and relies on the old `--next` JSON. The cockpit header still reads "norn cockpit" (a title, not a printed command).
- implement#1 done: status --watch [--interval/--pane/--json] replaces cockpit (pane split via new HerdrCockpit.openBelow, refused outside Herdr); run attach [<unit>] [--next] focuses the live agent pane, refused nothing_to_attach with the start command; norn cockpit is an unknown command; run lists attach. AC1–AC6 tested in status-watch.test.ts/e2e.test.ts; AC7 checked under a pty. Plugin still calls cockpit until slice 15.
